subject: obstetrics-gynaecology
title: FIGO Prognostic Score, Methotrexate and Actinomycin D

steps.tx: The scoring system predicting chemotherapy resistance risk in trophoblastic neoplasia is the **FIGO prognostic score**. Age, previous pregnancy type, interval, hormone level, tumour size, metastasis site and prior chemotherapy all score points. Totals divide patients into low and high risk treatment groups.
steps.say: The FIGO prognostic score totals eight factors to divide low and high risk treatment.

steps.tx: Scores of six or below define low risk disease treated with a single drug, the **low risk group**. Single agent methotrexate cures nearly all of these women. Resistance switches to the alternative single drug before combinations. Resistance to the first drug occurs in about a fifth, and switching early keeps cure at nearly 100 percent.
steps.say: Low risk scores of six or below cure with single agent methotrexate nearly always.

steps.tx: Scores of seven or above define high risk disease needing combination chemotherapy, the **high risk group**. The EMA-CO regimen alternates weekly drug blocks. Cure still exceeds ninety percent at specialist centres. EMA-CO means etoposide, methotrexate and actinomycin D alternating with cyclophosphamide and vincristine.
steps.say: High risk scores need EMA-CO combination chemotherapy with cure exceeding ninety percent.

steps.tx: The folate antagonist given by intramuscular injection on alternate days with folinic rescue is **methotrexate** in this setting. Mouth ulcers, conjunctivitis and pleuritic pain are its recognisable toxicities. Blood counts and liver tests precede each course. Folinic acid rescue starts 24 hours after methotrexate and continues for four doses in the eight day regimen.
steps.say: Methotrexate with folinic rescue causes mouth ulcers and pleuritic pain as recognisable toxicities.

steps.tx: The antibiotic derived chemotherapy drug rescuing methotrexate resistant low risk disease is **actinomycin D**. Given intravenously in pulses, it salvages most methotrexate failures without combinations. Hair loss and nausea exceed methotrexate effects. It is given as a five day pulse every two weeks, and extravasation causes severe tissue necrosis.
steps.say: Actinomycin D rescues methotrexate resistant low risk disease in most cases.

steps.tx: Hormone level at diagnosis scores heavily because it mirrors tumour burden, termed **hCG scoring**. Levels above one hundred thousand attract maximum points in that row. Serial levels thereafter are the supreme response marker. Levels over one million score maximum and also predict a uterus so vascular that biopsy would be dangerous.
steps.say: hCG scoring mirrors tumour burden, and serial levels remain the supreme response marker.

steps.tx: Interval from the causative pregnancy lengthens scores because older disease resists more, the **interval factor**. Disease declaring years after a term pregnancy scores worst. This partly explains why post term choriocarcinoma behaves aggressively. Metastases appearing more than four years after the causative pregnancy carry the poorest score in that row.
steps.say: The interval factor scores longer gaps worse because older disease resists treatment more.

steps.tx: Previous failed chemotherapy adds points and usually mandates combinations regardless of other factors, called **prior chemotherapy scoring**. These patients cluster in the high and ultra high risk groups. Newer immunotherapy options are transforming salvage here. Ultra high risk means a score of 13 or more, where induction chemotherapy precedes the full regimen.
steps.say: Prior chemotherapy scoring mandates combinations and clusters patients in high risk groups.

vis.alt: Prior chemotherapy entered on the FIGO prognostic score for gestational trophoblastic disease
vis.caption: Prior chemotherapy is scored on the FIGO chart, and a woman who has already been treated is directed to combination chemotherapy. Illustration: StewardMD original.

steps.tx: Ultra high risk disease with brain or liver spread may start with gentle induction chemotherapy to avoid early death from haemorrhage, termed **induction EP**. Full EMA-CO follows once stabilised. This sequencing cut early mortality dramatically in reported series. Low dose etoposide and cisplatin for two days, repeated weekly, is the gentle induction most centres use.
steps.say: Induction chemotherapy stabilises ultra high risk disease before full combination treatment.
